items.title: Numba now runs in browsers
items.oneliner: JupyterLite adds browser-side Numba and reports up to 249x faster scientific Python without any backend server.

items.title: Lazy promises with cancellation
items.oneliner: TypeScript async library adds laziness, cancellation, typed errors, and dependency injection without Observable complexity.

items.title: Grafana traces for Hermes agents
items.oneliner: Hermes plugin emits OpenTelemetry traces and metrics for LLM calls and tool runs into Grafana.

items.title: Monitor systemd jobs with pings
items.oneliner: Practical walkthrough shows how to wire systemd services to Healthchecks.io for success and failure alerts.

items.title: Magit status interface explained
items.oneliner: Hands-on tour shows how Magit's status view stages, unstages, and navigates Git state without leaving Emacs.

items.title: PyPI reproducible builds roadmap
items.oneliner: Detailed proposal maps the missing metadata and tooling needed to verify Python packages from source to wheel.

items.title: DuckDB asynchronous I O internals
items.oneliner: Engineering deep dive explains how async reads keep query threads busy on remote Parquet and CSV workloads.

items.title: Interactive math and physics simulators
items.oneliner: Browser-based simulations let you tweak wave, electrostatics, and quantum parameters to teach or prototype intuition fast.

items.title: Curriculum-bounded language model demo
items.oneliner: Open project explores what an LLM learns from only K-5 curriculum data and where transfer breaks.

items.title: Haskell history and future talk
items.oneliner: Long-form talk surveys Haskell's design tradeoffs, ecosystem evolution, and where functional tooling is heading next.
